 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The colored end bars sit on the first and last rows.
    top_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(g[0]) if v != bg]
    bot_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(g[-1]) if v != bg]
    bar_color = g[0][top_cols[0]]
    top_cols = [c for c in top_cols if g[0][c] == bar_color]
    bot_cols = [c for c in bot_cols if g[-1][c] == bar_color]
    top_left, top_right = min(top_cols), max(top_cols)

    # The lone interior marker selects the same offset in the opposite bar.
    counts = Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    marker_color = next(x for x, n in counts.items() if x not in (bg, bar_color))
    mr, mc = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, x in enumerate(row) if x == marker_color)
    offset = mc - top_left
    other_c = min(bot_cols) + offset

    # Extend inward from each bar; the marker is changed to the fixed hit color.
    for r in range(1, mr):
        g[r][mc] = marker_color
    g[mr][mc] = 4
    for r in range(h - 2, -1, -1):
        g[r][other_c] = marker_color
    return g
"
